name: Una Sombra en la Oscuridad
source:
Through the city streets of Valle Urb, an infamous murderer terrorizes its inhabitants because of the murders he has carried out over several years, and for this reason a detective named Ruber will have to race against the clock to be able to catch the dangerous murderer and rid the city of terror, but first he will also have to put his life in order if he wants to get out alive in the attempt.

[From [url=https://vulpxferainc.itch.io/una-sombra-en-la-oscuridad]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在Valle Urb城的街头，一名臭名昭著的杀人犯因多年来犯下的罪行而使居民陷入恐慌。侦探鲁贝尔必须争分夺秒抓住这名危险的杀人犯，解除这座城市的恐惧；但在此之前，他也得先理顺自己的生活，才有可能在行动中活下来。

[来源：[url=https://vulpxferainc.itch.io/una-sombra-en-la-oscuridad]Itch.io[/url]]
